title: Telugu-Speaking Sales & Customer Support Executive
description:
Stokastra Capital Management is looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented Telugu-speaking candidates to join our team in Dubai. The ideal candidate should have excellent Telugu communication skills, a customer-focused approach, and an interest in sales and client relationship management. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Handle inbound and outbound calls with Telugu-speaking clients. Explain company services, trading education and masterclasses to prospective clients. Generate leads and follow up with potential customers. Assist clients with queries and provide timely support. Maintain client records and update CRM databases. Build and maintain strong customer relationships. 
 Requirements 
 Fluency in Telugu is mandatory. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Basic English communication skills. Freshers and experienced candidates can apply. Sales, telecalling or customer support experience is an added advantage. Willingness to work from the Dubai office 
 Candidate Preference 
 Candidates currently based in UAE/Dubai are preferred. Indian candidates willing to relocate to Dubai may also apply. 
 Interested candidates can share their updated CV on support@stokastracapital.ae

Key Skills: Sales coordination,Telesales,Speaking Skills,Sales support,Outbound,Inbound,Coordination,BPO
